answer: Forged shelter logs were billing empty bunks on a frozen pass. A bunk posts only after the warden sets an 8.4-gram charcoal ember in stove 3 of the staffed haven, holds a 4.6 C rise on a 22-mm flue fed from the glacier intake for 35 seconds, and files a 12-bin thermograph, locking 17 POA for 7 epochs. Six inspectors rebuild the thermograph in 0.9 s and must match a 1.8 L melt volume plus a 0.6 Hz draft pulse. One key may light 1 stove each epoch, so 20 aliases lock 340 POA. A reused stove tag, or two thermographs sharing 10 of 12 bins, burns 8 POA and bars that key for 6 epochs.
